data.one_liner: An in-memory untyped data storage with querying and modification capabilities.
data.what_it_does: Provides an in-memory DataFrame structure for untyped tabular data storage, manipulation, and querying. It supports loading from CSV and JSON, adding or dropping series, sampling, shuffling, and mapping values. It also includes prefilled datasets like Iris, Pima Indians diabetes, wine quality, and Boston housing.
use_when: You need in-memory tabular data manipulation for machine learning tasks in Dart
You need to load and query CSV or JSON datasets directly in your app
You want to manipulate data columns and rows without setting up a full database
avoid_when: You require persistent local database storage with ACID guarantees
You are dealing with massive datasets that exceed device memory limitations
strengths: Includes built-in sample machine learning datasets
Flexible API for querying, filtering, mapping, and sampling data
weaknesses: Untyped data storage can lead to runtime type mismatches
